quotes.text: Bug 1809142 reported one extra empty contact for each imported SQLite mailing list. The address-book import tests reproduced the list/card distinction. The accepted fix skips card.isMailList in the ordinary-card copy loop, then imports each list and its member cards through the separate list loop. Current importer keeps the skip. When changing SQLite import, test a source with both a normal card and a list containing that card, and check the resulting card and list counts.
